FINDING 1 -- BLOCKING FOR MERGE, NOT THIS PR'S DEFECT, NOT FIXABLE BY A REVIEWER. A stale record is an unconditional hard FAIL, not merely an uncounted one: scripts/lwb_lanes.independent_reviews calls _review_ok on EVERY *.json in reviews/<pr>/ and _review_ok appends its STALE error regardless of how many fresh AGREEs sit beside it. Measured on this branch: with the two other records (reviews/46/cloud-reviewer.json and reviews/46/cloud-reviewer-clock-016Yb3Nh.json, both naming fd2a6fb) moved aside, lwb_lanes exits 0 on a single fresh record; with them present it exits 1 on them. So this PR CANNOT go green on my record alone -- someone with write scope over the whole directory, i.e. the author, must delete or refresh those two. I did not touch them: my authorisation is to write exactly one file, and deleting another reviewer's record is not mine to do. This is also why I overwrote the previous B record instead of adding cloud-reviewer-b-<my-token>.json, and why every reviewer routine that writes a per-run filename makes this worse. The same mechanism is why #45 is red right now (two records naming 073034f0) and why #51 stays red after my record landed there. It is a strong candidate for the next lwb_lanes.py change: treat a stale record as not-counting rather than as an error, or at minimum name in the message which party can clear it. This PR is itself the re-cut that had to 'drop two unclearable stale DISAGREE records', so the repository has now paid for this three times.
